nodes.title: A numerical criterion for a prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ above $r$ when $N = 2r + i$

nodes.summary: Let $N$ and $r$ be natural numbers with $r \ge 4$ and $3r \le N$, and let $e = r + \lfloor \sqrt{N} \rfloor + \lfloor N^{1/3} \rfloor \cdot \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. If $r \cdot 2^r \cdot (3r)^r \cdot 4^e < 3^r \cdot 4^r \cdot N^r$, then some prime $p$ with $r < p$ divides $\binom{N}{r}$.
nodes.title: A numerical criterion for a prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ above $r$ when $N \ge 3r$
